---
name: Report a problem
about: Something broke, looks wrong, or confused you
title: ""
labels: bug
---

**What happened?**
(What you did, what you expected, what you saw instead.)

**Which app?** (ZEditor, Markdown to PDF, ZineArranger, RGB to CMYK, Ai Tools, the home page, the wiki)

**Your device and browser** (for example: Android phone, Chrome; or Windows laptop, Firefox)

**The build number** (ZEditor shows it under its name at the top left; the wiki shows it at the bottom of the menu)

**Anything else** (a screenshot helps).

Please **don't attach private files or personal information**. If a file is needed, make a small example that shows the same problem.
